scope: Isolated native Chrome sidepanel guest acceptance runner for EXT-F-1003-T22, T37, T46, and T70

case_results.reason: Observed absent admin section warm and after reload in guest-settings-local-001 on 0.2.57.
Observed coming-soon hint, toggle persistence after reload, and restoration in guest-settings-local-001 on 0.2.57.

Valid save observed in two native runs. guest-settings-local-002 confirmed raw modifier key events did not select the old value on macOS. Runner now sends Chromium's documented selectAll editing command; retest pending. Worker rediscovery still needs separate observable evidence for a full pass.

guest-settings-local-002 observed matching identity and readiness, trusted scrolling to the update control, and a real no-update result. Browser API unavailable and alternate update outcomes remain unverified.

observed_failures: T46 port_input_not_observed: existing 65001 became 665365001 after Ctrl+A failed to select it on macOS.
T70 stable hit target failed: update button center y=573 was below the 421px native panel viewport.
defect_provenance.classification: Runner interaction failures; neither result establishes a product behavior defect.

second_run_provenance.result: T22 and T37 passed; T70 update button was reached by trusted wheel and the real browser returned no_update; T46 remained stopped at trusted select-all verification with value 65001 and selectionStart=selectionEnd=1.
second_run_provenance.repair_basis: Chromium DevTools Protocol Input.dispatchKeyEvent documents commands:['selectAll']; Chromium commit 3d3ee67f6904 says this command is needed for emulated Meta+A on Mac, and its protocol test proves selected text before Backspace.

source_leads_for_owner: T46 blank-port save does not clear a prior invalid-range error in SettingsView.tsx; the native runner checks for a stale error after clearing.
semantic_rulings: T70 inventory wording Ready describes supported password-flow APIs; Settings About explicitly labels that state Available. The oracle accepts Ready or Available only when the actual required browser APIs are present, and rejects missing or Unavailable in that branch. It requires Unavailable plus the reload/reinstall remedy when APIs are absent. No unavailable API or alternate update outcome is fabricated.
isolation: Existing native-sidepanel-qa-harness verifies receipt version, source revision ancestry, release tree hash, Store ZIP hash, extension ID and owned disposable Chrome profile. Its teardown terminates its own child process and removes the temporary profile.
test_method: Trusted pointer, wheel, and keyboard input through the owned native panel; DOM and chrome.storage reads for observation only; no product-state injection, mocked services, or auth changes.
execution_owner: Root guarded retest after source peer review and release/build gate.
